name: Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) Boolean Operations
definition: Computes boolean combinations (union, subtract, intersect, xor, stencil) of two polygonal meshes by partitioning space and clipping polygon sets against each other's BSP trees.
summary: Constructive Solid Geometry Boolean Operations compute mesh unions and intersections using BSP trees, avoiding grid quantization to produce watertight polygonal meshes.
